sermon.title: How Does a Just God Give a Second Chance? — July 18, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer asks how a just God gives a second chance. Because there was no law before Moses, Christ preached to the spirits in prison from Noah’s day; he suggests a just God may give a second chance to those who never understood, but urges taking it now. He criticizes faith-only teaching and lawless conservatives, calls free-salvation teaching socialism in the church, and closes with “neither do I condemn thee.”
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The message begins at 27:27 after worship. “Barnum” in the captions is taken as the Barna research group. He says God talked “to Noah through Elihu”; Elihu spoke to Job (Job 32–37).

faqs.question: Can we dictate how God comes?
faqs.answer: No; God dictates how you come to God.

faqs.question: Are Christians as much in debt as the world?
faqs.answer: He says yes, and they file bankruptcy as much.

faqs.question: Are we leaning too much on ministers?
faqs.answer: Yes; let the Holy Spirit change individuals and it will be infectious.

faqs.question: Did he doubt his salvation with flaws?
faqs.answer: Never; he knew he was going to heaven.
